id.description: Caller-supplied opaque id. A UUID is minted when omitted or null; an empty string is treated the same as omitted.

kind.description: What kind of physical obstacle a FixedStructure represents (ADR-0017).

footprint.description: A rectangular footprint — an origin position plus its extent (ADR-0017).

size.description: A rectangular footprint's extent, in metres (ADR-0017). All three must be strictly positive.
